messages:
sophie.product: Quick heads-up — we’ve opened a limited preview for MI300 Dedicated capacity in eu-central-3 (Berlin). :tada:

sophie.product: Why MI300? Better FP16 throughput for long-context models + much larger HBM, so customers running large-context embeddings and retrieval-augmented generation should see cost/perf wins.

aj.eng: Short tech notes: MI300 pool is configured with 2x-card hosts (4 chips total per machine), NVLink-equivalent fabric, and optimized kernel set. Expect ~1.8x throughput vs our current A800 baseline on long sequences (internal perf runs).

aj.eng: Hot path caveat — KV caching has a different memory footprint, so for very short, high-ppq workloads batching should still favor A800/L4.

maria.ops: Rollout plan: soft-preview starts today (limited quota), general availability targeted in 21 days pending perf regressions. Pool tag: mi300-eu-berlin-preview. Customers must request access via the sign-up form: https://internal.redwood/mi300-preview (internal)

maria.ops: If you’re onboarding customers, please use the “preview” tag so we can route telemetry separately. SLA is preview-tier (no uptime SLA) until GA. Billing rate will be preview-priced: "TBD-preview-rate" — finance will update once GA pricing is finalized.

deploy-bot: [capacity-event] created dedicated pool mi300-eu-berlin-preview (pool-id: pool-mi300-ber-01) by maria.ops at 2026-04-02T09:42:10Z

sam.sales: Heads-up for AE's — add a short blurb to deal docs: limited preview, performance wins for long-context LLMs, explicit quota required. I’ll circulate a canned email template later.

aj.eng: Ops checklist for SRE/Platform:
```
- Add mi300-eu-berlin-preview to routing policy with fallback to a800-eu-central as a lower-cost fallback.
- Limit each tenant to 2 nodes by default, request higher via support workflow.
- Enable prefix caching and KV shard balancing for these pools.
- Disable automatic quantization-preserve shortcuts (we’ll evaluate per-model).
```

aj.eng: Example redwoodctl command to create a reservation for QA use: 
```
redwoodctl reservations create --pool pool-mi300-ber-01 --units 2 --duration 14d --justification "mi300 preview QA"
```

devex_alex: I’ll update the dedicated capacity docs + quickstart page and add a short section on model compatibility and suggested configs. ETA: EOD tomorrow.

sophie.product: Action items: Aj — monitor perf signals and regression alerts; Maria — keep preview quota list; Alex — doc update; Sam — sales comms. Post any customer requests in this thread so we can track.

maria.ops: Noted. I’ll post weekly capacity snapshots in #eng-ops and ping here for major changes.

sam.sales: Thanks — will loop in top 10 accounts that asked for higher memory GPUs.

aj.eng: One more: if anyone sees unexpected OOMs or kernel timeouts, tag @aj.eng and include the job id + sample input.

sophie.product: Thanks all — excited to get this out. :white_check_mark: 

maria.ops: FYI for billing team: please hold GA pricing decisions until we have two weeks of stable telemetry.

sam.sales: :thumbsup: 

deploy-bot: [note] pool-mi300-ber-01 health: GREEN (all nodes reporting)

sophie.product: Closing the announcement — will follow up with a short internal FAQ in the next 24h.
